Push Nut for Holes (RPN)

A stop fastener in which multiple outward-splayed claws bite into the inner wall of a hole to hold it in place. No groove machining is required at all — it installs instantly simply by pushing it into the desired position, but once installed it cannot be reused without deformation. The spec symbol for this type is RPN.
